cases.sentence: Но ___ храма не включай и не измеряй, потому что он отдан язычникам, они будут топтать святой город сорок два месяца .
cases.explain: «внешний двор» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

cases.sentence: Им дана власть затворить небеса, чтобы в дни, когда они пророчествуют, на землю не шел дождь, а также власть превращать воду в кровь и поражать землю ___ столько раз, сколько они захотят.
cases.explain: «всевозможными бедствиями» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

cases.sentence: Их трупы будут лежать на улице ___, где и их Господь был распят, города, который символически назван Содомом и Египтом.
cases.explain: «великого города» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

cases.sentence: В тот же час произошло ___, и десятая часть города разрушилась.
cases.explain: «сильное землетрясение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

cases.sentence: Затрубил ___, и в небесах громко прозвучали слова:
cases.explain: «седьмой ангел» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

cases.sentence: Засверкали молнии, раздались голоса, загремел гром, произошло землетрясение, и пошел ___.
cases.explain: «сильный град» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.
